note: The study loop, shown as a stepper on every study item. Edit freely.

steps.name: Read
steps.do: Notes and warm-up; write definitions and key formulas only.

steps.name: Attempt cold
steps.do: No looking things up; at least 60 minutes per problem before any hint. Mark each: solved / partial / stuck, plus where you stalled.

steps.name: Supervision
steps.do: 1 hour, with Claude as the expert (the supervisor prompt).

steps.name: Redo
steps.do: Within 48 hours, redo every miss from a blank page.

cadence.sabbath: Friday sundown to Saturday sundown (Brooklyn, computed locally)
